_notes: gyms: case-insensitive regex (searched in workout title, description and all exercise notes) -> gym name; first regex with the most hits wins. Seeded from note tokens: 'The fitness', 'Klthe fit', 'Xxl', 'Xxl1'; 'technogym' -> The Fitness (Technogym machines are only in The Fitness; user fact).
_notesMatcher: anchor matcher: main block = Garmin duration - mainBlockOffsetMin (+/- mainBlockTolMin) and ends at the stream end (last set within endSlackMin); exercise 1's work sets (anchor) are searched with their first peak in [warmupWindowMin[0], mainBlockOffsetMin + anchorSearchMin] min, rest between them anchorRestS; any matched rest < shortRestS s is flagged low-confidence.
_notesMachineTokens: machineTokens: whole-word, case-insensitive note tokens that describe a MACHINE, not a gym ('Kl', 'Pq', 'sprava X' / '1sprava', 'masina', 'sjedeci', grip words 'siroki' / 'uski' / 'normal grip', 'technogym'). Gym inference: workouts without an explicit gym token get the gym whose explicit workouts are the only ones that used one of their machine / cable exercises (template, or template + machine token); conflicting evidence -> unknown (gymSource 'conflict').
